story_plan.moment: 40–200 characters, the concrete shutter moment and visible event
story_plan.meaning: 25–220 characters, why the event matters to this role

complete_world.full_wardrobe: A complete believable outfit, including offscreen garments and choices.
complete_world.full_action: What led to this exact action, including the physical movement outside the frame.
complete_world.offscreen_context: The world beyond the crop and what continues there.

choice.world: Specific fictional story world and situation
choice.role: Role or identity in this story

costume_plan.context_and_climate: Physical setting, season or weather and why the clothing fits.
costume_plan.role_foundation: What the role actually wears, with construction and materials.
material_anchors: Exact material substring in the compiled visible outfit
construction_anchors: Exact construction substring in the compiled visible outfit
costume_plan.style_adaptation: Complete design decision, including the chosen visible construction anchor or the exact cropped style phrase.
costume_plan.visible_style_detail: 20–150 characters. A visible construction from style_adaptation and how it shapes silhouette or layering. Empty if outside the crop.

camera_style.lighting: Named practical or ambient light, direction, bounce and effect
camera_style.texture: Actual materials and realistic depth of field
camera_style.framing: 8–140 characters. Show how the crop keeps the visible action and its contact, support or trace legible.

camera_plan.viewpoint: 20–145 characters, physical position, camera height and line of sight
camera_plan.optics: 12–150 characters, focal length and focus matched to the selected distance and crop
camera_plan.reason: 25–220 characters explaining why this viewpoint sees the story

photographer_selection.intentionally_unshown: Describe which story or outfit elements are unnecessary in this frame and why.
offscreen_not_requested: Exact phrase from complete_world or leave the list empty

scene_design.subject: 22–170 characters, role and what is visible
scene_design.setting: 22–245 characters, where and when with light-relevant features
scene_design.action: 22–270 characters, action visible at this shutter moment
scene_design.wardrobe: Remaining visible clothing, or an empty string. The visible style sentence plus this text totals at most 280 characters.
scene_design.action_physics: 50–170 characters, the visible joint and its grip, contact or support in this shot

emotion_review.visible_expression: 22–130 characters, literal visible change or state that the face is offscreen
emotion_review.review_note: 25–400 characters, how the final story, shot and expression were reconciled

creative_notes.story: 写明世界的一条具体规则、人物来到这里的理由，以及快门这一拍改变了什么。
creative_notes.emotion_action: 用这次独有的表情、视线、接触或支点，解释情绪由前一拍到这一拍的变化。
creative_notes.outfit: 说清材质、剪裁或功能怎样服务身份和行动。相关时交代完整衣装与画内部分的取舍。
creative_notes.camera: 解释为什么把机位放在这里、主要光源从哪里照到什么，以及裁切为什么能留住事件线索。
creative_notes.visible_clues: 指出两项实际可见的痕迹或关系，分别说明观众可从中推断出什么。
creative_notes.review_focus: 指出这张最容易出错的画面关系，以及看图时如何判断它有没有成立。

creative_audit.focus_evidence: Describe what was actually reviewed; preserve uncertainty where it remains.
